description: Image Description: The image depicts a steam locomotive traveling on railway tracks. The train is emitting a large plume of white steam as it moves forward. It is a classic, black steam engine with a series of passenger cars attached. The train is passing under a bridge, and there are buildings and a wall with graffiti on the right side of the tracks. Vegetation and grass are visible along the left side of the tracks. The scene is set in a bright, sunny environment, with clear skies overhead.
